Class LobbyController

java.lang.Object
it.polimi.ingsw.am14.controller.LobbyController
public class LobbyController extends Object
The root orchestrator and session gateway on the server side.

This class serves as the entry point for global cluster management, directing operations before players enter a distinct game loop context. It maintains multi-tenant indexing dictionaries linking player nicknames to active match rooms and mapping unique match IDs to specific GameController subunits.

Key infrastructure duties include:

  • User Onboarding: Handling entry authentication registration and handling active session reconnection loops.
  • Liveness Watchdog: Monitoring background heartbeats to safely disconnect unresponsive socket/RMI clients.
  • Asynchronous Persistence: Spawning detached non-blocking background threads to serialize the complete system state into cold storage after critical actions (picks, placements).

    • connectUser

      public void connectUser(String nickname) throws IllegalNicknameException, IllegalGameIdException, WrongStateException
      Processes inbound user entries requesting credential authorization or recovery mapping connections.

      Logic constraints:

      • If the nickname matches a historical active match placement, it initiates structural reconnection hooks.
      • If the nickname represents a first-time login, it registers the client into the global staging pool.
      Dispatches a LoginSuccesfulEvent forward down the wire upon completion to update client states.
      Parameters:
      nickname - text signature identifier selected by the client framework node
      Throws:
      IllegalGameIdException - if a historical match indexing record points to an absent engine instance
      WrongStateException - if structural model locks reject entry parameters down the pipeline
      IllegalNicknameException

    • createGame

      public void createGame(String nickname, int numPlayers, String totemColor) throws IllegalSetupException, WrongStateException, IllegalNicknameException
      Compiles a separate game core model node using structural factories, binds observers, hooks up sub-controllers, and assigns the creating player into the newborn match workspace context.

      Non-Blocking IO Pattern: Spawns an ephemeral worker thread named "Save-Thread-pick" to perform a background disk write task right after creation, ensuring zero delay on network queues.

      Parameters:
      nickname - the profile username creating the session lobby environment
      numPlayers - systemic scaling threshold sizing limits assigned to the room (2-5)
      totemColor - cosmetic identification option key chosen by the host player
      Throws:
      IllegalSetupException - if structural scaling configurations fail boundary tests inside factories
      WrongStateException - if state validation constraints block structural insertions
      IllegalNicknameException

    • disconnectUser

      public void disconnectUser(String nickname)
      Performs an immediate structural purge of a client session due to an explicit disconnect request or a watchdog heartbeat timeout.

      Tolleranza ai Guasti / Fault Isolation: If the departing client was inside a match, the system securely purges the entire associated GameController from current rosters. Active, healthy co-players are gently rolled back into the global lobby space. This design approach enables unaffected users to safely re-queue or establish new rooms without deadlocking the global server thread pool.

      Parameters:
      nickname - user signature profile token undergoing extraction

    • handlePingTimeOut

      public void handlePingTimeOut()
      Scheduled heartbeat verification routine executed at regular intervals by internal clock loops.

      It computes time deltas between the current system epoch and individual entry logs inside lastPingReceivedTime. Any node whose lag duration exceeds the defined PING_TIMEOUT threshold is forwarded to disconnectUser(String) to free up system resources.
